input.quote: 10.7 Survival. Sections 6.3, 7, 9 and 10 of this Agreement shall survive and continue in full force and effect for a period of two years from the expiration or termination of this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no indemnification, hold-harmless or defence language of any kind: the operative articles run 1 (HDI's Responsibilities), 2 (Company's Responsibilities), 3 (Fees), 4 (Term/Termination), 5 (Site Management), 6 (Exclusivity), 7 (Cross-Promotions), 8 (Confidentiality), 9 (Warranties) and 10 (General Provisions), and searches for "indemn", "hold harmless", "defend", "infringe" and liability language return nothing. Section 9 is limited to mutual authority/organisation warranties plus a Globix carve-out, and there is no limitation-of-liability clause. That is walk-away territory under INDEMN: HDI designs, develops, hosts and operates the Site and provides the software and administration tools (Sections 1.1-1.5, 1.9), so third-party IP infringement risk in what HDI builds and hosts sits with us with no recourse, as does any unauthorised access to Content and Site user information held on HDI's server. I have targeted the preferred position rather than the fallback because the Agreement has no liability cap at all, so importing the fallback's 3x-annual-fees super-cap would create a ceiling on HDI's exposure that does not exist today and would prejudice us. The single inserted Section 9A carries HDI's defence and indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, HDI-caused data breach and gross negligence/willful misconduct, the notice/control/cooperation procedure, and a Company indemnity expressly limited to Company-supplied Content and our own breach of law.

mappings.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.

proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 9A: HDI indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and gross negligence/willful misconduct, with notice/control/cooperation procedure and a narrow Company indemnity.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity at all, so we have added a new Section 9A under which HDI defends and indemnifies us against third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Site, HDI's breach of law, data breaches it causes and its gross negligence or willful misconduct, with standard notice, control and cooperation mechanics, and our own indemnity limited to Company Content and our breach of law. As a fallback we can work from an HDI IP indemnity with the customary Company-modification, combination and specification exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies.

ops.text: Indemnification. (a) HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Site or any software, deliverable or service provided by HDI infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (ii) HDI's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Confidential Information, Content or Site user information caused by HDI; or (iv) HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct. (b) The Company shall defend and indemnify HDI against any third-party claim to the extent arising out of the Content supplied by the Company or the Company's breach of applicable law, and the Company shall have no other indemnification obligation under this Agreement. (c) The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of any claim, the indemnifying Party shall control the defense of the claim, and the indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation in that defense.
